prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1459; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover on the vehicle is cracked and displaced on the driver's side, with the matching paint transfer and a dented quarter panel consistent with the reported impact. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known, and the pattern of deformation lines up with the way the collision was described. The proposed plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, refinishing the quarter panel, and recalibrating the parking sensors. The labor hours submitted run a little high for this scope of work, so I recommend a line-by-line review before approval. The invoices provided show no repeated charges.
